source: SEL-735 Power Quality and Revenue Meter Instruction Manual, appendix E (date code 20141107)
notes: Modbus RTU or TCP; functions 03 and 04 read the same register map (at most 125 registers per request), 06 and 16 write, 05 forces the output coils. Addresses are the decimal addresses of the manual and start at 0.

Data types: LONG is a signed 32-bit value (high word first); the numbers after LONG/INT/UINT in the manual (100, 10000) are scale factors, so a value of 12345 in a LONG100 register means 123.45. LONG registers without a factor (energy) are plain integers; their unit is not given in the register table.

Reserved registers are left out. The Sequential Events Recorder records at 225-287 (Selected Record +1 to +9, seven registers each), the 100 load-profile records (5186-9085, sixteen registers each, only record 1 is listed), configured registers 2-999 (1000-2997) and the user-mapped registers (9100-9349) are not listed individually.
The manual contains a few typing errors in the address columns (for example 438-489 for 438-439, and some hexadecimal addresses that repeat); the addresses here follow the decimal sequence.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
